brief.headline: Push price to ₹0.65–0.80/pc (market fair-band floor) and qualify Manjushree or Mold-Tek as a second source to earn better terms.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for price to move toward ₹0.65–0.80/pc for volume orders
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec. We should capture that headroom.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 Days After Receipt; do not extend

brief.financialLeverage: Empire Industries publishes no financials, so we don't know their revenue, profit, or how tight their cash is. We spend ₹67.47 L a year with them — without their revenue figure we can't gauge our clout. That means our best leverage is to line up a second source and show we have options. The price ask is grounded in the open market: the typical band is ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room down to ₹0.65–0.80 at scale — so the target is real, not a squeeze on a fragile supplier.

evidence.point: Market asking price band for 28 mm induction-wad PP cap
Market verdict: modest headroom exists to lower band at higher volume or looser spec
HDPE resin import unit value (raw-material benchmark)
Cash freed if we moved to 15-day-faster terms (not the ask, but the scale of working capital at stake)

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue; makes pharma bottles, caps, preforms; health score B (65/100) — a very strong second-source candidate once qualified.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹1010.97 Cr revenue (pails, containers, pharma); health score B (73/100) — robust alternate for bottles and closures once we audit them.

risks: Empire Industries does not publish financials — we fly blind on their stability and cash position, so watch for any sign of delivery or quality slip that might hint at trouble.
Without knowing their revenue, we can't tell if our ₹67.47 L spend gives us real negotiating weight or if we're a small customer — hedge by moving fast on a second source.
The market headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc assumes higher volume or looser spec — confirm our order size and tolerance before pushing hard, or the supplier will simply say no.
Manjushree and Mold-Tek are leads from web research, not qualified or priced — do not treat them as approved alternates until we audit capability, get quotes, and lock terms.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to work toward the ₹0.65–0.80 band the market shows for this cap at scale, and we're also qualifying a second supplier so we can grow volume with the partner who earns it.
